_purpose: Donate page FAQ entries, read by BOTH the web donate page (web/pages/donate-app.js) and the native one (src/gui/pages/donate.rs); tests/page_parity_lint.rs fails if either stops. Edit to add/remove/reword without recompiling. Order in this file is the display order. Rewritten 2026-10-04 from the operator's answer on where each kind of gift goes: say only what is true, with no amounts and no promises of what a gift pays for.

entries.question: Where does my money go?
entries.answer: It depends on which way you give. A donation to Sponsor-a-Can goes to Sponsor-a-Can, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. A gift through Patreon, GitHub Sponsors, PayPal or Cash App goes to Shaostoul, the maintainer, personally. The project's actual monthly income and costs are itemized in the For Funders and Sponsors guide in the Library.

entries.question: Is my donation tax-deductible?
entries.answer: A donation to Sponsor-a-Can is: it is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, so the gift is tax-deductible as the law allows. How much you can deduct depends on your own situation, so check with a tax advisor if it matters to you. A gift to the maintainer directly (Patreon, GitHub Sponsors, PayPal or Cash App) is a personal gift, and it is not tax-deductible.

entries.question: Is Sponsor-a-Can part of HumanityOS?
entries.answer: No. Sponsor-a-Can is its own nonprofit, and a donation to it goes to Sponsor-a-Can. HumanityOS has no company or nonprofit behind it. The maintainer serves as Sponsor-a-Can's Vice President. To give to the maintainer himself, use Patreon, GitHub Sponsors, PayPal or Cash App.

entries.question: Can I contribute without money?
entries.answer: Absolutely! Code contributions, bug reports, translations, documentation, and community building are all incredibly valuable.
